html: † עוּת vb. very dub.; only in לָדַעַת לָעוּת אֶת־יָעֵף דָּבָר Is 50:4 usually to help, so Ges Del Di RyKau; al., but in that case an Aramaism (Aramaic עות = Arabic غاث, q.v. sub עוּשׁ); text prob. corrupt, 𝔊 OortTh Times 1891, 469 לְעִתּוֹ, and del. אֶת־יָעֵף; Klo CheComm. לִרְעוֹת ‘teach, edify,’ Gr לַעֲנוֹת, CheHpt. לְהַחֲיוֹת.
